name: io.github.bitcompare/mcp-server
title: Bitcompare
description: Crypto yield data for AI agents: lending, staking and stablecoin rates. Free API key for core tools.

environmentVariables.name: BITCOMPARE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API key from https://auth.bitcompare.net/pro/signup. Format: ck_live_*. The pinned npm 1.1.0 package requires Pro or Enterprise; Free tools need npm 1.2.0 or the updated hosted endpoint.

apiKey.description: Bitcompare API key (ck_live_...). Free key at https://auth.bitcompare.net/pro/signup unlocks get_rates, get_rate_by_symbol, list_providers; other tools require Pro or Enterprise.
